text:
Talia (sales): Orchard Diagnostics wants to POC 'orchid-ensemble-42b' (ensemble of a 42B base + 2 lightweight specialist adapters) for diagnostic note summarization. They asked: how quickly can we onboard the model into the catalog, what are perf expectations, and what we need to support VPC + BYOK?
Noah (SE): quick checklist request: artifact format (sharded safetensors vs ckpt), are adapters LoRA or full modules, tokenizer compatibility, expected seq lengths, and traffic profile.
Priya (Orchard Diagnostics): artifact = sharded safetensors (6 shards). adapters = LoRA (diagnosis / lab-extraction). tokenizer = custom sentencepiece + extra token for lab codes. typical traffic: steady 80 rps, spikes to 300 rps; sequences 128-4k, rare 20k forensic docs. prefer VPC with BYOK and strict audit logs.
Ivy (solutions): suggested steps: 1) tokenization mapping test (ensure lab-code token preserved) 2) LoRA fusion path test (verify fusion -> safetensors shards) 3) KV/cache growth profile for 4k and 20k contexts 4) sharded load stress to detect OOMs during restart 5) perf/batching runs at 80/300 rps.
Noah (SE): compatibility upload command for staging:
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/models/compat
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST"
  -F "artifact=@orchid_ensemble_42b_sharded.tar.gz"
  -F "meta=@meta.json"
  -F "samples=@orchid_samples.zip"
```
Talia (sales): I'll send the upload link and ask Priya to include tokenization examples and label PHI vs non-PHI samples. Priya, can you also include an example where adapters disagree?
Priya (Orchard Diagnostics): yes, uploading in ~3h. will include adapter-disagreement cases and a 20k stress doc.
Samir (security): intake items: completed vendor security questionnaire, data flow diagram, KMS ARN for BYOK, retention policy, and confirmation that PHI logs are disabled or redacted. For FedRAMP / HIPAA mapping ask, do you need any extra attestations?
Priya (Orchard Diagnostics): HIPAA is required; FedRAMP not needed. BYOK + HSM preferred, and we need contract language for audit log access.
DeployBot: scheduled compat job #cj-9921 on 2025-11-02T01:00:00Z (staging). est runtime 1h10m.
Noah (SE): perf guidance: 42B ensemble with fused LoRA on A100s int8 -> expect p95 token latency ~120-200ms for <=512 tokens with batching; 4k contexts will push memory and KV overhead; 20k will be heavy and might mean falling back to truncated contexts or segmented calls. We'll supply measured numbers post-run.
Ivy (solutions): pricing note: I'll draft Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private estimates. short takeaway: if >1% calls hit 20k, Dedicated/Private with large-memory nodes likely needed; else hosted may be cost-effective.
Samir (security): enforcement rule idea: metadata.sensitivity=high -> route_policy=private-only + disable external telemetry. we'll draft the clause for legal.
Talia (sales): owners: upload (Priya), compat tests (Noah), pricing (Ivy), security intake (Samir). ETA: samples today -> tests tomorrow -> initial perf/pricing by Fri. I'll update the deal doc. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Orchard Diagnostics): uploaded artifacts & samples. thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround.
Noah (SE): starting tokenizer + shard-load tests now. will post raw numbers and any blockers in this thread.
Ivy (solutions): noted. prepping price options and fallback routing language.
Samir (security): initiating questionnaire review. will follow up if we need the legal addendum.
